Evidence contradicts the legacy note '2017 premiere date is a fixed past event': on the current page, 15 December 2017 is the air date of the series 5 finale 'What Lies Beneath' (s1), not a premiere; series 5 part 2 premiered 12 October 2017 and series 6 premiered 11 January 2018 (s2).
